subject.title: tools.exec.approvalRunningNoticeMs is documented but rejected by the 2026.3.24 config schema

question: How should maintainers resolve the open conflicting fork PR that carries the exact schema fix?
rationale: The product/code direction is clear, but the existing linked PR is outside the target repo, conflicting, and not maintainer-editable, so automation should not open a duplicate repair until that candidate is resolved.

options.title: Replace with same-repo repair
options.body: Open or adopt a narrow same-repo branch for the schema move, preserve credit for the prior repair work, and close the conflicting fork PR once the replacement exists.

options.title: Wait for fork rebase
options.body: Ask the fork author to resolve conflicts and provide a maintainer-editable branch before reviewing the PR as the landing vehicle.

options.title: Remove the documented knob
options.body: Retarget docs away from the global key only if maintainers decide the runtime should not support this existing documented config path.

recommendation.title: Replace with same-repo repair
recommendation.body: Open or adopt a narrow same-repo branch for the schema move, preserve credit for the prior repair work, and close the conflicting fork PR once the replacement exists.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the best available routing candidate because the documented config behavior traces to their commit and the decision is about preserving or correcting that config surface.
